{{Top}}
A '''flask''' was a container for liquids such as [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages. [[Margo Flarestream]] carried a [[Liter/Legends|liter]] flask on her person at all times.<ref name="CRO">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref>

Flasks were also one of the suits in the game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref>
